name: 07676 · Twp Washinton, NJ
findings: ZIP 07676 (Twp Washinton) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07676 (Twp Washinton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
